# ASU Elsevier Pure

> > Arizona State University's expert directory and research database platform for discovering academic profiles, research outputs, and fostering scholarly collaboration.

ASU Elsevier Pure is the official research information management system for Arizona State University, powered by Elsevier's Pure platform. It provides a comprehensive directory of ASU experts, research publications, and collaboration opportunities while maintaining accessibility standards and security best practices.

## Key Topics

- Arizona State University
- expert directory
- research database
- academic profiles

## Core Platform

- [Arizona State University](https://asu.elsevierpure.com): ASU expert directory and research database for academic profiles and collaboration
